_comment: Curated GDC-CMU arcade gallery. See README.md -> 'Adding a game'. Only entries with launchable=true are ever cloned or executed; coming-soon entries deliberately carry no repository, ref or entrypoint.

games.title: Street Fighter
games.description: A vintage arcade-style fighting game featuring four unique professor characters, each with their own special abilities and fighting styles.
games.note: Press P1 to go back one level; exit from the main menu.

games.title: Pac Dawg
games.description: A maze chase where Scotty hoovers up kibble across the CMU-Q campus while four rivals hunt him down.
games.note: Press P1 to go back one level; exit from the main menu.

games.title: Head Scotter
games.description: Head-soccer where Scotty and a rival bounce around a pitch trying to bundle the ball into the net.
games.note: Press P1 in-game to go back a level.

games.title: Pass The Game
games.description: Start with a simple game. Pass it on. Watch it evolve into something unpredictable. No rules, just creativity and surprises.
games.note: Controller focus and context actions; save before returning to the gallery.

games.title: Flappy Scotty
games.description: Navigate through tricky obstacles, flap your way through dangerous hazards, and protect Scotty to reach the farthest point possible in the Flappy World.
games.note: Original game pack with Solo, PVP and controller name entry.

games.title: Smart Ways To Die
games.description: Try to die in the smartest way possible in the shortest amount of time.
games.note: Start confirms; B or P1 pauses or goes back one level.

games.title: Spicy Adventures
games.description: Go on an adventure with some extra spice.
games.note: Native Godot adventure; either controller can play.

games.title: UFO Race
games.description: A two player game where you are an alien roaming in the space with your bestie.
games.note: Local two-player game using both sticks; no server required.
